verification: Shipped Wasm disassembly plus IL2CPP field offsets and serialized Unity objects. No gameplay execution.

formatNumber.culture: No explicit provider in native code; Single.ToString(format) uses current culture.

prestige.upgrade: Manual action increments PrestigeLVL by 1, hides the upgrade holder, calls LoadStats; muscle scores remain unchanged.

rank.note: Independent of prestige and muscle strength. Native code indexes directly; end-of-roster boundary is outside this audit.

muscleMorph.rule: For each part, Lerp startProduct.localPosition/Scale to original part localPosition/Scale; Quaternion.Lerp rotations; t=Clamp01(the group's prestige fraction).
muscleMorph.awake: Muscle.Awake captures original final local position/rotation/scale before any morph.
muscleMorph.note: LoadStats initially sets all multipliers to 0.1, then replaces each with its calculated fraction; no 0.1 minimum in the final morph.

workoutGain.completion: Update completes when workoutProgress >= 0.99; CompleteWorkout adds strength to curWorkoutType + Strength, updates HUD/body, resets workout bar and refreshes recommended weight.
workoutGain.note: Weight changes repetition speed/difficulty; level base and trainer muscle modifier determine strength gain in the inspected completion path.

recommendedWeight.note: CalculateRecommendedWeight additionally rounds to a multiple of 5 again and enforces minimum 5.

rangeHelper.note: No Clamp01 in this helper; consumers clamp for Image fill and transforms.
